cards.back: Brackets, Orders (powers), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction. It tells you the order to work in.
cards.say: What does BODMAS stand for? Brackets, Orders, powers, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction. It tells you the order to work in.

cards.back: 14. Multiply first: 3 × 4 = 12, then add 2.
cards.say: Two plus three times four. Fourteen. Multiply first: three times four equals twelve, then add two.

cards.back: 20. Brackets first: 2 + 3 = 5, then 5 × 4 = 20.
cards.say: Brackets two plus three, then times four. Twenty. Brackets first: two plus three equals five, then five times four equals twenty.

cards.back: 17. Divide first: 6 ÷ 2 = 3, then 20 - 3 = 17.
cards.say: Twenty minus six divided by two. Seventeen. Divide first: six divided by two equals three, then twenty minus three equals seventeen.

cards.back: 16. Division and multiplication go left to right: 8 ÷ 2 = 4, then 4 × 4 = 16.
cards.say: Eight divided by two times four. Sixteen. Division and multiplication go left to right: eight divided by two equals four, then four times four equals sixteen.

cards.back: 8. Addition and subtraction go left to right: 10 - 4 = 6, then 6 + 2 = 8.
cards.say: Ten minus four plus two. Eight. Addition and subtraction go left to right: ten minus four equals six, then six plus two equals eight.

cards.back: 27. Brackets first: 4 + 5 = 9, then 3 × 9 = 27.
cards.say: Three times, brackets four plus five. Twenty seven. Brackets first: four plus five equals nine, then three times nine equals twenty seven.

cards.back: 6. Brackets first: 2 + 1 = 3, then 18 ÷ 3 = 6.
cards.say: Eighteen divided by, brackets two plus one. Six. Brackets first: two plus one equals three, then eighteen divided by three equals six.

cards.back: 9. Work out the power first: 2² = 4, then 5 + 4 = 9.
cards.say: Five plus two squared. Nine. Work out the power first: two squared equals four, then five plus four equals nine.

cards.back: 24. Multiply first: 4 × 5 = 20. Then 6 + 20 - 2 = 24.
cards.say: Six plus four times five minus two. Twenty four. Multiply first: four times five equals twenty. Then six plus twenty minus two equals twenty four.

cards.back: The last digit is even (0, 2, 4, 6 or 8).
cards.say: Divisibility test for two. The last digit is even, zero, two, four, six or eight.

cards.back: The digits add up to a multiple of 3. Example: 312 has 3 + 1 + 2 = 6, so 3 goes into it.
cards.say: Divisibility test for three. The digits add up to a multiple of three. Example: three hundred and twelve has three plus one plus two equals six, so three goes into it.

cards.back: The last two digits make a number that 4 goes into. Example: 3,124 ends in 24 and 24 ÷ 4 = 6.
cards.say: Divisibility test for four. The last two digits make a number that four goes into. Example: three thousand one hundred and twenty four ends in twenty four and twenty four divided by four equals six.

cards.back: The last digit is 0 or 5.
cards.say: Divisibility test for five. The last digit is zero or five.

cards.back: The number is even and its digits add to a multiple of 3.
cards.say: Divisibility test for six. The number is even and its digits add to a multiple of three.

cards.back: The last three digits make a number that 8 goes into. Example: 1,128 ends in 128 and 128 ÷ 8 = 16.
cards.say: Divisibility test for eight. The last three digits make a number that eight goes into. Example: one thousand one hundred and twenty eight ends in one twenty eight, which is eight times sixteen.

cards.back: The digits add up to a multiple of 9. Example: 7,263 has 7 + 2 + 6 + 3 = 18, so 9 goes into it.
cards.say: Divisibility test for nine. The digits add up to a multiple of nine. Example: seven thousand two hundred and sixty three has seven plus two plus six plus three equals eighteen, so nine goes into it.

cards.back: The last digit is 0.
cards.say: Divisibility test for ten. The last digit is zero.

cards.back: Yes. The last two digits are 16 and 16 ÷ 4 = 4.
cards.say: Is five hundred and sixteen divisible by four? Yes. The last two digits are sixteen and sixteen divided by four equals four.

cards.back: No. 7 + 1 + 4 = 12, which is not a multiple of 9.
cards.say: Is seven hundred and fourteen divisible by nine? No. Seven plus one plus four equals twelve, which is not a multiple of nine.

cards.back: No. It is odd, so 2 does not go into it.
cards.say: Is one hundred and thirty five divisible by six? No. It is odd, so two does not go into it.

cards.back: No. 234 ÷ 8 = 29.25, so 8 does not go into 234.
cards.say: Is one thousand two hundred and thirty four divisible by eight? No. Two hundred and thirty four divided by eight is twenty nine point two five, so eight does not go into it.

cards.back: Yes. It ends in 5.
cards.say: Is two thousand three hundred and forty five divisible by five? Yes. It ends in five.

cards.front: True or false: if a number is divisible by 8, it is also divisible by 4
cards.back: True. 8 = 4 × 2, so anything that 8 goes into, 4 goes into too.
cards.say: True or false: if a number is divisible by eight, it is also divisible by four. True. Eight equals four times two, so anything that eight goes into, four goes into too.
